US distillate stocks were 105.1M bbl in the week to 2026-10-02 (12-13% below the 5-year average), gasoline 5% below, and utilization 92.7% after a 96.8% peak in September. RBN says cracks turned down in early October but were still more than 2.5 times October 2025. Iran talks (Trump ruled out a strike before the 2026-11-03 midterms) are now the main risk to margins. EPA's final 2026-27 RFS (26.81B RINs, 70% SRE reallocation) keeps D4 RINs strong.
